scope: The Forest of Love 0.45 preliminary ready Dialogue Text/Menu Text family, en→ru; independent correction review, not whole-game acceptance
ordering: Canonical dialogue-candidates.jsonl order; UTF-8, LF after every ID/JSONL row

mandatoryRegressions.name: hidden-neutral-and-collective-speakers
mandatoryRegressions.reason: Unestablished mouse/spa speakers, collective agreement, wolf name reveal and external-player gender. Broader named scene groups are used because actor IDs are reused.

mandatoryRegressions.name: save-load-menu-title-credit-ui
mandatoryRegressions.reason: Dialogue-family save/load, labels, menus, input/tutorial and credits surfaces. Other game/UI/image families remain outside this preliminary inventory.

mandatoryRegressions.name: mixed-controls-and-layout
mandatoryRegressions.reason: All matching visible/control units, markup span semantics, timing, placeholders, dynamic joins, exact-symbol and layout-sensitive fields. Full protected values are also checked deterministically for all 12246 IDs.

mandatoryRegressions.name: source-dispositions
mandatoryRegressions.reason: Complete existing source-bound preserve manifest, unknown bracket syntax, constructed language and six OPEN literal source placeholders; retained classifications are proposals, not source acceptance.

limits: Static original consumer code and serialized graph only: the game, actual Lua variable values, BGDatabase caller state, direct external node calls, fonts, wrapping and renderer were not run.

The ready dialogue inventory is finite and exact; complete-game/UI/image coverage is not accepted. Cross-family semantic dependencies can remain unknown. Widen the independent review to the entire selected conversations and all listed concept/wording hits; the selector is a reproducible review boundary, not proof that every possible semantic callback is exhaustively known.

Do not silently accept held source/consumer questions or credit this author's preflight as independent review. Any newly discovered dependency must repair this specification/selector in a new immutable cycle.
contextPolicy: For each changed unit walk the actual graph in both directions until two display-bearing units per branch; skip empty passthrough/cue nodes without inventing translation IDs. Keep full raw selected scene topology in a separate hashed context component. For class/wording/repetition/regression hits add the nearest real predecessor/successor through nontext nodes.
classSelectors: class-spec.json; exact authored regex bounds and all emitted class reads
repetitionPolicy: Exact source and old/new complete target repetitions plus portrait-stripped NFKC/case/apostrophe/dash/whitespace-normalized source variants
wordingPolicy: Actual changed contiguous old/new spans of at least two words; shorter grammatical differences are bounded by the explicit complete class enumeration and object/exchange context
explicitInvalidation: Changed exchanges minimal current context, three rejected independent findings and all source/target/context mismatches. Other prior support is retained only after exact version checks; no blanket full-support reread.
deltaFormula: changed IDs union(current closure minus exact complete 11295 prior support IDs) union explicitly invalidated old evidence
removedDependencies: Prior 11295 support is retained version-wise wherever valid. Historical broader whole-conversation/concept selections not selected by these current finite predicates are recorded as removed from the required current closure, not deleted from prior coverage.
